about: Calls the OLD sprite generation dialog sent, recorded black-box on 2026-11-19 against a throwaway server (old dialog at b5df84f4a6). Paid commands (sprite_generate_sheet_preview, sprite_generate_sheet, sprite_cleanup) were answered by fakes; sprite_upload, sprite_list and sprite_capabilities_command reached the server. Pictures are labels: fake:cellN / fake:cellN-full are the fake reply's N-th cell (512x512 portrait, 512x768 full-body, solid colour with a black border and a dark dot), fake:<cols>x<rows>[-full]:sheet the whole fake sheet, fake:avatar the test avatar, fake:clean the fake cleanup result (transparent 512x512), other:<hash>:<length> a picture the dialog made itself (re-cut or framed). Each scenario lists the sprite_* calls in order with their arguments (and, for faked or failed calls, the reply), plus the sprite names saved on the server afterwards. The test character has an avatar; the default connection select shows gpt-image-1 first.
